description: Modernize dependencies and Docker images across all four services. Bump packages to current latest (Express 5, node-cron 4, fluent-ffmpeg latest 2.1.x, cors latest), remove bogus/builtin npm deps and unused auth packages, rewrite Dockerfile.peakfilegenerator to base on node:26-bookworm and install audiowaveform 1.10.2 from the BBC bookworm .deb (the old ubuntu:20.04 + ppa:chris-needham/ppa is dead), add a .dockerignore, and update readme.txt from docker-compose (v1) to docker compose (v2). This is the build-level foundation; FEAT-002's security code changes build on these upgraded deps. Independent of FEAT-002 in content but MUST run first so the Express 5 / node-cron 4 toolchain is in place before frontend code is edited against it.
steps: Read /home/hoogden/Desktop/GIT/audiostreamlogger/.worktrees/security-update/.agents/tasks/context.json and this file FIRST. Re-confirm the latest stable versions online (express 5.x, node-cron 4.x, fluent-ffmpeg 2.1.x, cors 2.8.x) and that audiowaveform_1.10.2-1-12_amd64.deb is the correct bookworm/amd64 asset — do NOT use a version that does not exist on npm (the task text's fluent-ffmpeg ^2.1.27 is not real; latest 2.1.x is 2.1.3).
Edit cleaner/package.json: remove the bogus deps 'fs' and 'path'; bump 'node-cron' to ^4.6.0.
Edit recorder/package.json: bump 'fluent-ffmpeg' to the latest 2.1.x (^2.1.3) and 'node-cron' to ^4.6.0.

Edit frontend/package.json: remove basic-auth, express-basic-auth, child-process, fs, fs.promises, index.js, and node-cron (none are used by the frontend); bump express to ^5.1.0, keep cors ^2.8.5, bump fluent-ffmpeg to ^2.1.3. Do NOT add any auth packages.

Rewrite Dockerfile.peakfilegenerator: base on node:26-bookworm; install audiowaveform via `curl -fsSL -o /tmp/aw.deb https://github.com/bbc/audiowaveform/releases/download/1.10.2/audiowaveform_1.10.2-1-12_amd64.deb && apt-get update && apt-get install -y /tmp/aw.deb && rm -f /tmp/aw.deb && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*` (installing the .deb by path pulls its runtime deps; ensure curl is available — node:26-bookworm includes curl, but if not, apt-get install it in the same layer). Keep WORKDIR /usr/src/app, COPY peakfilegenerator/package*.json ./, npm install, COPY peakfilegenerator/peakfilegenerator.js ./, mkdir -p /usr/src/app/audio, CMD ["node","peakfilegenerator.js"].
Create .dockerignore at the worktree project root with entries: node_modules, **/node_modules, audio/ (and optionally .agents/, .git).

Edit readme.txt: replace every hyphenated 'docker-compose' with 'docker compose' (including the build/run example and the stopping section, adding a `docker compose down` example where the stop instruction is incomplete).
acceptance_criteria: No package.json in any service lists fs, path, child-process, fs.promises, index.js, basic-auth, or express-basic-auth.
frontend/package.json pins express ^5.1.0, cors ^2.8.5, fluent-ffmpeg ^2.1.3 and nothing else; recorder/cleaner/peakfilegenerator use node-cron ^4.6.0 (plus fluent-ffmpeg ^2.1.3 in recorder).
Dockerfile.peakfilegenerator uses FROM node:26-bookworm and installs audiowaveform from the BBC .deb (no ubuntu, no ppa:chris-needham).
A .dockerignore exists at the worktree root excluding node_modules and audio/.
`docker compose build` builds ALL FOUR images successfully.
verification: cd /home/hoogden/Desktop/GIT/audiostreamlogger/.worktrees/security-update && docker compose build  (all four images build; peakfilegenerator .deb install and Express5/node-cron4 npm installs succeed)
findings:
Done and verified. Versions re-confirmed online at implementation time (registry.npmjs.org dist-tags + GitHub release API):
- express: latest 5.x is 5.1.0+ (npm 'latest' tag). Pinned frontend to ^5.1.0.
- node-cron (nodecron.com package): latest 4.6.0. Pinned recorder/cleaner/peakfilegenerator to ^4.6.0.
- fluent-ffmpeg: npm dist-tags.latest = 2.1.3 (confirmed via registry.npmjs.org/fluent-ffmpeg). The '2.1.27' seen in npm search is a DIFFERENT package (gulp-fluent-ffmpeg plugin), not fluent-ffmpeg; ^2.1.27 does not exist for fluent-ffmpeg. Pinned recorder + frontend to ^2.1.3.
- cors: latest 2.8.6; kept ^2.8.5 as instructed (satisfies 2.8.6).
- audiowaveform .deb used: audiowaveform_1.10.2-1-12_amd64.deb (as specified by the task). SURPRISE/NOTE: a newer amd64 asset audiowaveform_1.10.2-1-13_amd64.deb also exists on the same 1.10.2 release (published 2025-08-13, sha256 4208706c...; ~63k downloads vs ~29k for -12). Both are valid bookworm/amd64. Used -12 per explicit task instruction; -13 is a drop-in alternative if a future bump is wanted.

Removals: cleaner dropped bogus 'fs' and 'path'. frontend dropped basic-auth, express-basic-auth, child-process, fs, fs.promises, index.js, node-cron, path (no auth added). frontend now lists only cors ^2.8.5, express ^5.1.0, fluent-ffmpeg ^2.1.3.

Dockerfile.peakfilegenerator rewritten: FROM node:26-bookworm; installs curl then the .deb by path (apt resolves runtime deps: libsndfile, libmad, libmp3lame, libFLAC, libvorbis, etc.); removed old ubuntu:20.04 + ppa:chris-needham. .dockerignore added at worktree root (node_modules, **/node_modules, audio/, .agents/, .git). readme.txt: all docker-compose -> docker compose, added 'docker compose down' under Stopping.

Verification: `docker compose build` -> all four images built (peakfilegenerator .deb install + Express5/node-cron4/fluent-ffmpeg npm installs all succeeded, 0 npm vulnerabilities reported for peakfilegenerator). `docker compose run --rm peakfilegenerator audiowaveform --version` -> 'AudioWaveform v1.10.2'. `grep -n docker-compose readme.txt` -> no output. node:26-bookworm did NOT ship curl preinstalled in practice-safe-guarded by installing curl in the same RUN layer. Lockfiles are regenerated by npm install inside images; not hand-edited (none are checked into the worktree).
